name: filter-polish-4258e694
description: Полировка редактора отбора, часть 1 (ошибка 4258e694; пункты 2, 11, 12а, 12б): онбординг → «Структуры» → фраза-превью из сохранённого отбора без «все условия», с именами (не id) и оператором «И» → двухрядный футер (действия сверху, имя+сохранённые снизу), не уезжает при прокрутке дерева → сплиттер раздвигает панель до предела. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.filter-polish-4258e694.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-4258e694/out

labels.value: Очень длинное имя типа мысли для проверки обрезки

steps.name: panel-metrics-initial
steps.probe: (() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.body); const canvas = document.querySelector('.structures'); const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); return JSON.stringify({ innerW: window.innerWidth, editorPos: document.body.dataset.editorPos ?? null, editorW: cs.getPropertyValue('--editor-w').trim(), canvasW: canvas ? canvas.clientWidth : null, panelW: panel ? Math.round(panel.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null }); })()

steps.name: focus-splitter
steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.st-filter + .fp-splitter') || document.querySelector('.fp-splitter'); if (!s) return 'no-splitter'; s.focus(); return document.activeElement === s; })()

steps.name: panel-metrics-at-max
steps.probe: (() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.body); const canvas = document.querySelector('.structures'); const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const results = document.querySelector('.st-results'); return JSON.stringify({ innerW: window.innerWidth, editorPos: document.body.dataset.editorPos ?? null, editorWPx: parseFloat(cs.getPropertyValue('--editor-w')) || 0, canvasW: canvas ? canvas.clientWidth : null, panelW: panel ? Math.round(panel.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null, resultsW: results ? Math.round(results.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null }); })()

steps.name: panel-reaches-half-canvas
steps.probe: (() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('.structures'); const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const w = panel ? panel.getBoundingClientRect().width : 0; const c = canvas ? canvas.clientWidth : 0; return JSON.stringify({ panelW: Math.round(w), canvasW: c, halfCanvas: Math.round(c / 2), ratio: c ? +(w / c).toFixed(3) : null }); })()

steps.name: panel-at-half-canvas
steps.probe: (() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('.structures'); const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); if (!canvas || !panel) return false; const w = panel.getBoundingClientRect().width; const c = canvas.clientWidth; return Math.abs(w - c / 2) <= 1; })()

steps.name: phrase-no-service-words
steps.probe: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-preview__text')?.textContent ?? ''; return !t.includes('все условия') && !t.includes('любое условие'); })()

steps.name: phrase-uppercase-and
steps.probe: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-preview__text')?.textContent ?? ''; return t.includes(' И ') && t.includes('Есть комментарий'); })()

steps.name: phrase-name-not-id
steps.probe: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-preview__text')?.textContent ?? ''; return !t.includes('11111111-1111') && t.includes('Очень длинное имя типа мысли…'); })()

steps.name: phrase-tooltip-names
steps.probe: (() => { const tip = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-preview__tip'); const t = tip ? tip.textContent : ''; return t.includes('Очень длинное имя типа мысли') && !t.includes('11111111-1111'); })()

steps.name: footer-two-rows
steps.probe: (() => { const act = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-actions'); const nm = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ff-name'); return JSON.stringify({ actions: !!act, name: !!nm, applyTop: !!(act && act.querySelector('.ff-apply')), clearTop: !!(act && act.querySelector('.ff-clear')), commandsTop: !!(act && act.querySelector('.ff-extra--commands')), savedNotTop: !(act && act.querySelector('.ff-extra--saved')), nameInputBottom: !!(nm && nm.querySelector('.ff-name__input')), saveBottom: !!(nm && nm.querySelector('.ff-save')), savedBottom: !!(nm && nm.querySelector('.ff-extra--saved')) }); })()

steps.name: add-many-conditions
steps.eval: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { const btn = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft-add-condition'); if (!btn) break; btn.click(); } return document.querySelectorAll('.st-filter .ft-row').length; })()

steps.name: tree-metrics-detail
steps.probe: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const ft = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ft') : null; const g = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ft-group') : null; const row = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ft-row') : null; const cs = (e) => e ? getComputedStyle(e) : null; return JSON.stringify({ innerH: window.innerHeight, ft: ft ? { sh: ft.scrollHeight, ch: ft.clientHeight, ofy: cs(ft).overflowY, h: Math.round(ft.getBoundingClientRect().height) } : null, group: g ? { sh: g.scrollHeight, ch: g.clientHeight, ov: cs(g).overflow, h: Math.round(g.getBoundingClientRect().height), collapsed: g.classList.contains('collapsed') } : null, footH: panel ? Math.round(panel.querySelector('.fe-foot').getBoundingClientRect().height) : null, rowH: row ? Math.round(row.getBoundingClientRect().height) : null, rows: panel ? panel.querySelectorAll('.ft-row').length : null }); })()

steps.name: footer-outside-tree-scroller
steps.probe: (() => { const ft = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft'); return ft ? ft.querySelector('.ff-actions') === null && ft.querySelector('.fe-foot') === null : 'no-tree'; })()

steps.name: footer-tree-scroll-metrics
steps.probe: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const ft = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ft') : null; const foot = panel ? panel.querySelector('.fe-foot') : null; const actions = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ff-actions') : null; if (!panel || !ft || !foot) return 'missing'; const pr = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); const fr = foot.getBoundingClientRect(); const ar = actions ? actions.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return JSON.stringify({ treeScrolls: ft.scrollHeight > ft.clientHeight + 1, treeScrollHeight: ft.scrollHeight, treeClientHeight: ft.clientHeight, footTop: Math.round(fr.top), footBottom: Math.round(fr.bottom), panelTop: Math.round(pr.top), panelBottom: Math.round(pr.bottom), footOverflow: Math.round(fr.bottom - pr.bottom), actionsVisible: ar ? ar.bottom <= pr.bottom + 1 && ar.top >= pr.top - 1 : null }); })()

steps.name: tree-scrolls-when-long
steps.probe: (() => { const ft = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft'); return ft ? ft.scrollHeight > ft.clientHeight + 1 : false; })()

steps.name: scroll-tree-to-bottom
steps.eval: (() => { const ft = document.querySelector('.st-filter .ft'); if (ft) ft.scrollTop = ft.scrollHeight; return ft ? ft.scrollTop : null; })()

steps.name: footer-visible-after-tree-scroll
steps.probe: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const foot = panel ? panel.querySelector('.fe-foot') : null; const actions = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ff-actions') : null; if (!panel || !foot || !actions) return 'missing'; const pr = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); const ar = actions.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ actionsBottom: Math.round(ar.bottom), panelBottom: Math.round(pr.bottom), visible: ar.bottom <= pr.bottom + 1 && ar.top >= pr.top - 1 }); })()

steps.name: footer-visible-after-scroll-assert
steps.probe: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('.st-filter'); const actions = panel ? panel.querySelector('.ff-actions') : null; if (!panel || !actions) return false; const pr = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); const ar = actions.getBoundingClientRect(); return ar.bottom <= pr.bottom + 1 && ar.top >= pr.top - 1; })()
